title: EnvironmentRunResult
description: The outcome of one EnvironmentRunRequest. EVIDENCE only: serves_truth is always false — an environment run produces a measurement (a RewardResult by reference) and an agent output, never served/promotable truth. status is one of succeeded|failed|unavailable (unavailable = environment could not run, e.g. requires Docker/network not available locally). The agent output is carried by value (small) or by reference; it is the thing being MEASURED, not a fact the spine vouches for.

status.description: succeeded = environment ran to a verdict; failed = ran but errored; unavailable = could not run (missing local capability/Docker/network)

output.description: inline agent output when small + non-sensitive; the measured artifact, never auto-served

output_ref.description: ResourceRef-style handle to the agent output when large or sensitive

steps_taken.description: number of agent steps actually consumed (<= request.max_steps)

reward_result_id.description: id of the RewardResult produced for this run (the measurement); null when status=unavailable

receipt_id.description: id of the EnvironmentRunReceipt emitted for this run

serves_truth.description: ALWAYS false — an environment run is evidence/measurement, never served or promotable truth
